ALPINE PEAK RANGE — a serrated spine of light-bley + dark-bley slope-brick summits crowned with white-plate snow-caps, tier after tier of receding ridge-lines built from stacked wedge-plates, a foreground scree-field of dark-tan round-plates spilling down the lowest flank toward a flat grey-plate valley floor.

GLACIER-CARVED VALLEY — a broad U-shaped valley of stacked dark-grey slope-brick walls, a sinuous trans-light-blue + white-plate glacier-tongue descending the floor in layered plate courses, hanging tributary valleys notched into the upper walls, a dark-bley round-brick moraine arc at the glacier snout.

REDWOOD OLD-GROWTH GROVE — colossal dark-brown + reddish-brown round-brick and large-cylinder trunk-columns rising past the upper frame edge, a dense green plant-element canopy far overhead, a fern-element + dark-tan plate understory below, vast open shaft-spaces between each towering trunk column.

DESERT SLOT-CANYON — sheer soaring walls of stacked tan + orange + dark-red plates with every sedimentary stratum a distinct plate-course, a winding tan-plate sandy floor below, sculpted slope-brick overhangs at mid-height, a narrow sliver of light-blue plate sky visible far above the compressed walls.

SEA-CLIFF COAST — sheer dark-grey + light-bley slope-brick cliffs dropping vertically to a trans-blue + trans-light-blue plate sea surface, white round-plate foam rings at the base, isolated BURP-element sea-stack pillars offshore, a green + sand-green plate clifftop meadow running along the full upper rim.

ALPINE WILDFLOWER MEADOW — a vast sweeping green + sand-green plate meadow tiled edge to edge, dense clusters of plant-element stems topped with round-plate flower-heads in yellow + magenta + white, a dark-green brick-pine belt at the far edge, white-plate-capped slope-brick peaks rising as a full backdrop.

PLATEAU MESA BADLANDS — a staggered family of flat-topped mesas built from stacked red + tan + cream plates with stepped slope-brick flanks, narrow brick-wash channels between each formation, a foreground spread of round-plate scree, brush-element desert scrub, and crumbling wedge-plate butte fragments.

BRAIDED RIVER DELTA — a wide tan + sand plate floodplain divided by interweaving channels of trans-blue + trans-light-blue plates splitting repeatedly around flat brick gravel-bar islands, tiny dark-tan round-plate sediment fans at each channel junction, distant slope-brick foothills framing the entire aerial-scale landform.

FJORD — a long narrow trans-blue plate inlet cutting deep inland, flanked by sheer grey + dark-bley slope-brick walls descending straight to the waterline, white-plate snow resting on the high rims, green plant-element brick-pine clusters clinging to the lower slopes, the inlet narrowing into a deep-distance brick horizon.

VOLCANIC CALDERA — an immense circular crater of dark-bley + black slope-brick walls enclosing a flat caldera floor, a central vent of stacked trans-orange + trans-red lava-element bricks, broad hardened lava-flow plates in dark-red + black fanning outward, a broken rim of red-brown round-plate scree along the crater edge.

SEQUOIA GROVE AT THE BASE — a tight stand of enormous rust-brown + dark-orange round-brick trunks with cheese-slope bark-texture panels rising far above frame, deeply ridged surfaces built from alternating offset brick courses, a dappled dark-tan + green plate grove-floor below, a high green plant-element canopy glimpsed at the very top.

CANYON RIVER-BEND — a great horseshoe loop of trans-blue plates curving around a towering central stacked-plate rock-pinnacle in tan + orange + dark-red, layered canyon walls receding in both directions, a foreground high-overlook of slope-brick rim-rock plates, the inner bend a flat tan-plate sand-bar.

FROZEN WATERFALL CLIFF — a sheer dark-bley slope-brick cliff face draped with vertical columns of stacked white + trans-light-blue plates forming frozen-flow pillar formations, broad ice-sheet wedge-plates fanning from the base, a foreground of white round-plate ice-debris, the towering cliff wall extending the full depth of the build.

KARST SPIRE FIELD — a dense forest of towering grey + light-bley round-brick and cylinder-stack limestone spire columns rising from a dark-green plate valley floor, each spire topped with small plant-element vegetation, vine-element strands draped between columns, layered plate cave-mouth openings cut into the base of several spires.

ROLLING TUNDRA — an immense undulating plain of dark-tan + olive-green + sand-green plates rolling in low brick-hill mounds to the horizon, sparse plant-element low shrub clusters and round-plate lichen patches across the surface, a distant slope-brick ridge-line of low dark-bley hills defining the far edge.

BUTTE FIELD — a wide red + tan plate flatland punctuated by a dozen isolated flat-topped buttes of stacked wedge-plate and slope-brick construction in orange + dark-red + cream, each butte casting a distinct stepped shadow-profile, round-plate rubble fields at every base, the flat plate desert stretching between them.

COASTAL DUNES — sweeping arc-shaped dune ridges of stacked tan + light-nougat + white plates with smooth slope-brick faces, crests built from curved wedge-plates following flowing lines, inter-dune valleys of flat tan plates, a trans-light-blue plate sea-surface visible beyond the furthest dune crest on the deep-distance horizon.

SAVANNA — a vast flat tan + dark-tan plate plain extending to a low slope-brick horizon ridge, sparse tall dark-brown round-brick trunk columns with green plant-element canopy-crowns distributed across the plain, dry brush-element clumps and round-plate rock outcroppings scattered across the foreground and mid-distance ground plane.

HANGING VALLEY WATERFALL CLIFF — a high grey slope-brick plateau edge with a broad curtain of layered trans-light-blue + white plates descending in stacked horizontal courses down the cliff face, a white round-plate splash-field at the base, the upper plateau built from flat dark-bley tiles, lower valley walls in stacked tan plates.

ALPINE GLACIER ICEFALL — a stepped glacier of white + trans-light-blue layered plates breaking over a dark-bley slope-brick cliff edge in compressed block-shaped serac formations of stacked brick courses, deep crevasse gaps between plate-stacks, a foreground moraine of dark-grey round-bricks, high slope-brick peaks flanking both sides of the icefall.

DESERT ARCH CANYON — a monumental freestanding arch of stacked tan + orange + dark-red slope-bricks and curved wedge-plates spanning a wide gap, the arch shoulders rising from a flat tan-plate canyon floor, layered sedimentary canyon walls in receding bands of tan + cream extending deep into the background behind the arch.

COASTAL SEA-STACK ARCHIPELAGO — a cluster of tall isolated BURP-element + slope-brick sea-stack columns of dark-grey + light-bley rising from a trans-blue + trans-light-blue plate sea floor, each stack capped with small green plant-element vegetation, white round-plate surf rings at every base, a distant slope-brick headland closing the background.

SALT FLAT PLAYA — an immense perfectly flat expanse of white + light-grey + light-bley smooth tiles stretching to every horizon edge, low geometric polygon-plate salt-crust pattern seams across the surface, a cracked dark-tan plate border zone at the playa edges, a distant backdrop of low dark-bley slope-brick mountain silhouettes.

LAVA FIELD SHORELINE — a broad expanse of jet-black + dark-grey textured plate lava-field built from offset staggered brick courses meeting a trans-blue + trans-light-blue plate ocean edge, white round-plate surf-foam at the contact zone, older lava-flow ridges of dark-red plates elevated above the flat field, slope-brick volcanic cones in the distance.

DEEP CANYON LABYRINTH — an intricate maze of towering narrow canyon walls built from stacked tan + orange + rust-red plates in tight parallel corridors, each wall capped with flat slope-brick rim-rock, a deep-shadow dark-grey plate canyon floor threading below, converging corridors receding into a complex stacked-plate depth of interlocking canyon arms.
